contributor.cloneCommand: git clone https://github.com/reponerve/reponerve && cd reponerve && make install

homebrew.note: Homebrew tap packaging exists; until published, use the install script or release archives.

teamPitch: Hey team, we're setting up RepoNerve for our repository. It scans git, ADRs, and code structure once and builds local software memory (.reponerve/memory.db). Developers and AI agents query that memory for why something exists, who owns it, and what breaks if we change it — instead of grepping every session. Run reponerve init and reponerve scan; it plugs into Cursor, Copilot, and other MCP hosts. No cloud required.
demoScript:
# 1. Install & verify binary
reponerve --version

# 2. Go to your local git repository
cd /path/to/your-repo

# 3. Initialize workspace database
reponerve init

# 4. Scan repository & build memory
reponerve scan

# 5. Diagnostic check & orientation onboarding
reponerve doctor
reponerve onboard

# 6. Task planning, reuse check, and code review
reponerve plan "Add webhook notifications"
reponerve reuse-check "add webhook"
reponerve review "webhook"
reponerve ship-check "webhook"

default.title: Default Profile
default.subtitle: Local-first SQLite memory and ADR ingestion
default.description: Default local-first settings: SQLite memory, ADR ingestion, no external AI provider.
default.code:
repository:
  path: "."

storage:
  sqlite_path: ".reponerve/memory.db"

ai:
  provider: "none"

ingestion:
  document_paths:
    - path: "docs/adr"
      format: "markdown"
outcomes: AI provider disabled (deterministic scan and query)

setupSteps.title: Step 1 — Install RepoNerve
setupSteps.body: Install globally via npm, the install script, or go install — then run reponerve --version.

setupSteps.title: Step 2 — Initialize & Scan
setupSteps.body: From your repo root: reponerve init then reponerve scan to build local memory.

setupSteps.title: Step 3 — Verify Setup
setupSteps.body: Run reponerve doctor to check memory health, scan freshness, and MCP configuration.

setupSteps.title: Step 4 — Understand Code
setupSteps.body: Use reponerve onboard, reponerve ask, and reponerve explain-* before editing.

setupSteps.title: Step 5 — Plan and Ship
setupSteps.body: Run reponerve plan, reuse-check, review, and ship-check before merge.

setupSteps.title: Step 6 — Connect AI Tools
setupSteps.body: Run reponerve mcp or use MCP config installed by init in Cursor, VS Code, or Copilot.
